title: Add Logout button that deletes user data locally and from global rankings

requirements.text: Add a backend canister endpoint that lets the authenticated caller delete their own user record so they are removed from the global leaderboard/ranking data.

quotes: and also add a logut button , if we press  it the data should be erased  from the the database and ranking

acceptanceCriteria: A new shared backend method exists in `backend/main.mo` that deletes the `users` map entry for `caller` (no other users can be deleted by a non-admin).
After deletion, the caller no longer appears in `getGlobalRankingPaginated` results.
If the caller has no stored user record, the method returns a safe, non-trapping result indicating nothing was deleted (or a successful no-op).
The method enforces the same authorization expectations as other user-mutating endpoints (must be an authenticated user, not an anonymous/guest caller).

requirements.text: Add a Logout button in the Settings screen that, when confirmed, (1) deletes the current user from the backend ranking database and (2) erases all locally stored app data on the device, then returns the user to the Login screen.

quotes: add a logut button , if we press  it the data should be erased  from the the database and ranking

acceptanceCriteria: Settings displays a clearly labeled button: "Log out".
Pressing "Log out" opens a confirmation step with clear English copy explaining deletion impact (local data will be erased and leaderboard data will be deleted).

On confirm, the app calls the new backend delete endpoint when a backend actor is available; failure to reach the backend is shown as a clear English error and the app does not claim the leaderboard deletion succeeded.

On confirm, the app clears local app persistence by clearing IndexedDB (via the existing IndexedDB client) and resets in-memory state using the existing reducer action `RESET_ALL` so `state.userProfile` becomes null.
On confirm, the app clears any locally cached ranking data (e.g., the `rankCache` localStorage cache) so stale leaderboard data is not shown after logout.
After local erase completes, the UI returns to the Login flow (login gate is shown because `state.userProfile` is null).

requirements.text: Ensure the logout flow also logs the user out of Internet Identity so the next session starts unauthenticated.
acceptanceCriteria: The logout flow calls Internet Identity clear/logout using the existing `useInternetIdentity().clear()` API (without modifying any immutable files).
After logout, backend actor calls requiring authentication are no longer possible until the user logs in again via Internet Identity (where applicable).
User-facing error/success messages during logout are in English and do not show raw stack traces.

constraints: Do not edit any files listed under `SYSTEM_CONTEXT.frontend.immutablePaths`.
Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister; implement changes in `backend/main.mo` only.
Do not introduce external databases or third-party auth providers beyond Internet Identity.
Use English for all user-facing text added or modified.
nonGoals: Do not change core attendance tracking logic or calculations.
Do not add account recovery, multi-account switching, or admin user management UI.
Do not implement scheduled/background deletions; deletion happens only when the user explicitly logs out and confirms.
